prompt:
Create one production sprite atlas for NPC074 angry mouth poses, using the supplied exact 3×3 repeated-original-lower-half grid as the only reference image.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: native pixel-art portrait mouth atlas
Composition: Exactly 3 columns × 3 rows, each cell a complete lower 64×29 crop; overall 64:29 cell aspect ratio. Row-major A B C / D E F / G H X. No labels, gutters, borders, full faces, or independent feature closeups.
Expression: Clearly angry through firm, pressed lips and restrained tension. Keep corners controlled, not extremely downturned. Preserve source mouth scale and original pale pink/terracotta lip hue.
Exact Rhubarb meanings:
A: pressured closed P/B/M.
B: narrow opening, teeth nearly together, consonants/EE.
C: medium unrounded EH/AE.
D: wide AA.
E: slightly rounded AO/ER, no wider than C.
F: puckered UW/OW/W.
G: upper teeth touching lower lip, F/V.
H: tongue raised behind upper teeth for L, opening between C and D.
X: relaxed closed idle.
Keep every pose recognizable at native pixel scale. Teeth must be muted gray-ivory, distinct from skin, with modest oral-cavity contrast; no tooth gaps. Show teeth only for poses that need them.
Preserve NPC074 nose, jaw, hair, blue ornament, background, and crop registration. Maintain original muted pale palette and soft pixel shading.
Avoid: lipstick-red lips, skin-colored teeth, bright white tooth flashes, shiny teeth, oversized mouths, black outlines, extreme frowns, changed nose/jaw/hair, blur, text, or added features.
